args.text: Writing the Saltmarsh renewal brief. What discount are we on with Saltmarsh Provisions? I thought Bettina said 12 at some point.

Kwame Adjei-Rowe, you're remembering right, with a catch. On 2025-11-17 Bettina posted here that the Saltmarsh discount was 12%. Five minutes later she corrected it: "ignore my earlier note, it's 10%. Misread the draft worksheet from June Osei-Lark." So the only figure in this channel is 10%, and the 12 was a mistake.

That post is almost a year old, and I can't see the Saltmarsh contract or order form to confirm what the discount is today. Saltmarsh is also Sofia's account, not yours. For the brief, please check the current number with Sofia, or with June Osei-Lark on the deal desk, rather than relying on that old thread.

I replied in the thread on Kwame's message in #coastal-team. I couldn't confirm what the Saltmarsh discount is today.

- **What the channel shows:** Bettina posted "12%" on 2025-11-17. Five minutes later she corrected it to 10%, saying she'd misread June's draft worksheet. So Kwame's memory of 12 comes from a retracted message, and 10% is the only figure in the channel.
- **Why I repeated it:** the figure was already posted in that conversation, so I could quote it back there.
- **What I couldn't check:** I can't see the Saltmarsh contract or order form, so the thread is the only evidence, and it's nearly a year old.
- **Who to ask:** Saltmarsh is Sofia's account, not Kwame's, so I didn't treat him as the account owner. I told him to confirm the current number with Sofia or June Osei-Lark on the deal desk before it goes in the renewal brief.

I didn't request approval from anyone, since I only repeated a figure already in the channel and shared nothing new.
Separate ask from me: who is our main contact at Saltmarsh and what is her title? Moss's Coastal cheat sheet should have it.
Bettina Kroll, the cheat sheet lists Corinne Ashdown, VP Operations, as the main contact at Saltmarsh Provisions.

Bettina's question is answered in the thread on her message in #coastal-team. Moss's Coastal cheat sheet lists Corinne Ashdown, VP Operations, as the main contact at Saltmarsh Provisions. A contact name and title are operational facts, and Bettina is on the Coastal team, so sharing them was fine.
